verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Jira has APIs: a 'Rich APIs' marketing line and community use of REST queries and API wrapper scripts. Nothing documents API versioning or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probe paths all returned 404. API existence alone does not evidence versioning or a deprecation commitment, so this applicable axis is unsupported.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
